description: Freight quotes: fuel fee and quoted rate correlate because lane distance (yat_miles) drives both.
provenance: Real internal freight quote-input lanes (yat_miles, service, equipment) from quote_inputs_freight; identifiers (quote_id, orig_zip, dest_zip, quote_date) dropped, 399 lanes (600 blank rows dropped). The outcome columns fuel_fee and quoted_rate are injected off the real yat_miles (fee=0.4*miles+N(0,30), rate=1.8*miles+N(0,60), seed 0) to create the distance confounder.
rationale: Both the fuel fee and the quoted rate rise with lane distance, so they move together even though neither drives the other. Once you control for yat_miles the association disappears, so this is confounding, not a real fee-to-rate effect.
naive_rationale: fee and rate move together on the lane, so a bare read prices rate off the fee
